title: 6.3 Ellipses

icans: I can write the standard equation of an ellipse.
I can find the center, vertices, and foci of an ellipse.
I can find and interpret eccentricity.

vocab: the set of points whose ____________ from two fixed points (the foci) have a constant sum
the chord __________ the foci; its endpoints are the vertices
the chord through the center ________________ to the major axis; its endpoints are the co-vertices
e = c/a, which measures how ____________ an ellipse is

blocks.p: Draw an ellipse with the tacks and string, then move the tacks and draw again.

head: Tacks
Shape: rounder or flatter?
Sum of distances from one point to both tacks

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Standard form (center (h, k)): horizontal major axis (x − h)²/a² + (y − k)²/b² = 1; vertical major axis (x − h)²/b² + (y − k)²/a² = 1, with a _______________ b.

blocks.stem: Write the standard equation of the ellipse with center (0, 0), vertices (±5, 0), and co-vertices (0, ±3).

notes: Foci: c units from the center along the major axis, with c² = _______________.

blocks.stem: Find the foci of x²/25 + y²/9 = 1.
Write x² + 4y² + 6x − 8y + 9 = 0 in standard form. Find the center, vertices, and foci.
Write the equation of the ellipse with foci (0, ±2) and vertices (0, ±4).

notes: Eccentricity e = c/a: near 0, the ellipse is nearly a _______________; near 1, it is long and thin.

blocks.stem: Find the eccentricity of x²/25 + y²/9 = 1. Is it nearly circular?
